column3: Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979 and shall have effect as section
144A.  (1)  The  Magistrate  may,  at  his

discretion,  dispense  with 
the  personal
attendance of a suspect or accused in court, in
respect of whom  criminal proceedings have
been  instituted  before  such  Magistrate,  for
extending  the  period  of  detention  or  for  any
other  purpose,  at  the  end  of  each  detention
period, or on each trial date.
(2) The personal attendance of the suspect
or  accused  may  be  so  dispensed  with,  on  an
application  made  by  the  relevant  person,  as
specified in subsection (3), if the Magistrate is
satisfied that the personal attendance of such
suspect or accused in court may be dispensed
with,  on  any  one  or  more  of  the  grounds
specified in subsection (4).
